comments.author: Guilder
comments.body:
This version is color-custom (green/purple/blue) and requires a lifetime accumulated total of 240k Roman Coins on a character before it becomes available at Lorenzo's office from his sewing maid, Roberta. At least... 240k is the total recorded from the JP server from the blogger, while JP wiki states it can appear around 233k Coins.

As you can only hold a max of 50k Roman Coins on one char at a time, it takes a lot of work to unlock this recipe and according to JP wiki, Coins obtained from dungeons do not count toward your total. Additionally, the stats aren't so good so the only reason to pursue this would be for the looks.

I wonder whether anyone in Maris can actually make it, or if the Coin total was lowered for us somewhat. Cheers..

Source/pics: white-jasmin.jugem.jp/?eid=206 , gvo.gamedb.info/wiki/?Recipe/Special
